tools.name: list_floatout_plans
tools.description: Read current publicly purchasable Floatout activation plans, prices, revenue-share terms and browser purchase links. Checkout requires the owner's wallet. Does not create an order or make a payment.

tools.name: read_floatout_page
tools.description: Read a public Floatout product, pricing, security or operator guide as Markdown. Returns current published content with its source URL. Does not sign in or change a platform.

tools.name: read_builder_fee_study
tools.description: Read Floatout's fixed September 10–23, 2026 archive sample of gross Hyperliquid builder fees in USDC, including daily data and coverage limitations. Not Floatout revenue or expected customer earnings.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_floatout_page · Private data: list_floatout_plans · Public sink: list_floatout_plans.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_floatout_page · Private data: list_floatout_plans · Public sink: list_floatout_plans

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
